reason: The premise suggests that Asia has the highest number of child workers and Sub-Saharan Africa has the highest proportion of working children, leading to the conclusion that Asia has a high child labour rate. This contradicts the factual position that child labour rates can vary independently of the number and proportion of child workers in different regions.
refined_position: Relational contradiction due to the independent variability of child labour rates across regions despite differing numbers and proportions of child workers.
